Jordan: Morning — quick async check from sales (what I did / blockers / today)
Jordan: What I did: moved NovaHealth LOI to legal, answered initial pricing Qs, pushed MacroHealth security questions to ENG/SEC.
Jordan: Blockers: waiting on SSO answers for MacroHealth (INC-4682). Also need sign-off on dedicated pricing for one mid-market deal.
Jordan: Today: follow up with MacroHealth, prep dedicated pricing slide for Thursday, sync with legal on NovaHealth. @Ryan (security) can you ping on SSO timeline? @Mira please refresh pipeline. :wave:

Mira: Quick Q — would a redwood-hosted test environment help their SOC review, or do they want SP metadata only? cc @Ellie

Sam K: FWIW, ENG said SSO answers are ~48-72h if no infra changes. We need their SAML metadata + cert. I dropped this snippet in the customer thread:
```
Please upload your SP metadata XML and public cert; we'll validate and respond with ACS/EntityID details.
```

Ellie: We can provide the compliance summary + SOC2 excerpt for MacroHealth. I'll add docs to the shared drive folder and link customer. For a hosted test env we need legal sign-off (MSA addendum).

Ryan (security): Looking into INC-4682 now — aiming to have initial answers by EOD. Note: for Dedicated/Private deployments we require SP metadata + a cert from the customer. If they want us to stand up a hosted test env we need a formal request + legal addendum.

sec-bot: Security intake update: INC-4682 assigned to Ryan (security). Expected response SLA: 72h. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4682

Jordan: Thanks all — @Sam K can you paste the SAML steps into the MacroHealth thread and nudge the customer for metadata?

Sam K: Done — pasted steps + templated next actions. :thumbsup:

Ryan (security): I'll post a formal checklist in the ticket with required artifacts (metadata, cert, contact person).

Jordan: Wrapping — short standup complete. Will follow up on NovaHealth legal escalation offline. :rocket:
